_about: Indian Pharmacopoeia limits entered by hand for the demo: numbers and monograph references only, no monograph text. Loaded by the 'ip' source (redis-loader/sources/ip.py) into data/sources/ip.json, the first source in the limits chain (backend/app/limits.py). Add molecules by appending entries; check every value against your licensed IP edition before relying on it.

monographs.title: Paracetamol Tablets

assay.text: Assay 95.0–105.0% of the stated amount of paracetamol (IP 2022, Paracetamol Tablets)

dissolution.text: Paddle, 900 mL phosphate buffer pH 5.8, 50 rpm, 30 min; Q not less than 80% of the stated amount (IP 2022, Paracetamol Tablets)

monographs.other_tests: Complies with the general monograph Tablets

monographs.title: Telmisartan Tablets

assay.text: Assay 90.0–110.0% of the stated amount of telmisartan (IP 2022, Telmisartan Tablets)

dissolution.text: Paddle, 900 mL phosphate buffer pH 7.5, 75 rpm, 30 min; Q not less than 75% of the stated amount (IP 2022, Telmisartan Tablets)

related_substances.text: Related substances (LC): any secondary peak ≤ 0.5%, sum of secondary peaks ≤ 2.0%

monographs.other_tests: Complies with the general monograph Tablets
